_comment: The jurisdiction of English-language documents (core/jurisdiction.py): [value, pattern] pairs, the first match wins, after the packs of the other languages. jurisdiction_designations match the start of the designation (else of the title): international bodies (ISO, IEC, ITU, IMO, register rules: INT) apart from the national ones of the United States (API, ASME, ANSI, ASTM, NFPA, UL, FM, IEEE, ISA, MSS, AGA, GPA, NACE …: US), European standards (EN: EU) and a few national ones (BS: GB, DIN: DE, NORSOK: NO, CSA: CA, AS: AU). A dual designation goes by its first body (IEC/IEEE 80005: INT; ANSI/ISA: US). jurisdiction_words: the names of a state, a union or an international body in the title, the publisher or the source name of a normative document, and (when they say nothing) in the start of its text; a document they give two values is left unsure.
